items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Moe Gail started booking us... Moe Gail, asked me, what was so and so talking to you about... Moe Gail said you don't need no money from him, take that check and give it back to him. You get it from us.

ctx.x: We was being booked by -- well, Johnny Tomino in Consolidated but then after we got ready to go east, then Moe Gail started booking us, and so all of this was put together real quick, just like the big band, see, the big band was put together, boom, quick and all of this was one of those quick things.

And while we got out -- book was why we discontinued they had the book going and they had these head tunes going all the time too so we played a place in Tulsa, Oklahoma, that's the first time we heard Confessing Blues on the record. And somebody went downtown in Tulsa and they says, man, -- a couple of guys in the band, they went down there and they heard somebody in a booth playing it and they went over and listened and they said, that's us. So they bought the record and brought the record back out.
